title: Rabbi Yose ben Yaakov (Rain-Blessing Notice)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2, he visits Rabbi Yudan Migdalaya. While he is there, rain falls, and he hears Yudan saying, “A thousand thousands…are obliged to give thanks.” He asks where Yudan learned it; Yudan replies that Rabbi Simon used to bless this way. Bereshit Rabbah 13:15 has the same account. He is also mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 3:1 and at the end of Bava Kamma 8:1.

notes.text: The complete Berakhot paragraph confirms Yose as visitor and Yudan as host/blesser. It names Yose bar Yaakov, where the notice has ben. Another catalog notice shares the heading; the rain-blessing qualifier distinguishes this notice, not a different authority identity.
